pages.title: Brave Wallet adds shielded Zcash transactions on desktop, with Android and iOS coming soon | Brave
zcashStatements: Brave Wallet adds shielded Zcash transactions on desktop, with Android and iOS coming soon
April 2, 2025 — Starting today, Brave users can conduct shielded Zcash transactions in the browser-native Brave Wallet with the updated desktop release (v1.77).

This integration is part of the ongoing partnership with Zcash/ECC and Filecoin Foundation announced at Mainnet 2023 , which now allows the privacy-preserving Zcash native currency (ZEC) to be bought, sent, and received directly within Brave Wallet.
Adding shielded transactions with Zcash to Brave Wallet gives users a way to send and store crypto privately.
Extending Brave Wallet privacy with Zcash
Zcash aims to solve this problem.
Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that forked and adapted an early version of the Bitcoin codebase.
Transactions in Zcash can be controlled by either a transparent address (t-addr) or a shielded address (z-addr), allowing users to choose between public and private transactions.

pages.title: Brave Wallet now supports NEAR Intents | Brave
zcashStatements: The Brave Wallet enables multi-chain access right from the Brave browser, and NEAR Intents is the first swap provider that ties together nearly all of our supported blockchains: Bitcoin, Solana, Zcash, Cardano, and EVM (including Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, etc).
Brave Wallet users now have a decentralized way to swap assets like BTC and ZEC that traditionally lack DEX options.
Transparent ZEC to any chain
Any chain to transparent ZEC
Shielded ZEC to any chain
Any chain to shielded ZEC
Additionally, if the user is spending shielded ZEC, they are always returned back to the shielded pool in case of a refund.
Shielded transactions with Zcash in Brave Wallet give users a way to send and store crypto privately.

pages.title: Brave, Electric Coin Co., and Filecoin Foundation announce partnership to bring new privacy tools to Web3 | Brave
zcashStatements: With support from ECC, Brave will integrate the Zcash protocol in the browser’s built-in crypto wallet so users can securely store, send, and receive ZEC alongside other cryptocurrencies.
“I’m excited about integrating Zcash into the Brave web browser because privacy should be normal.
Not only do we hope to make it simple to use ZEC for private transactions, but we also aim to maximize privacy during key moments of purchase or exchange.”

Brave, ECC, and Filecoin Foundation also teased plans on stage to develop a new, privacy-based feature in the Brave browser that will offer private messages and media transmission via the Zcash protocol.
Electric Coin Co. launched Zcash in 2016 and continues to support the protocol and user experience, alongside other developers and teams.
Zcash is a cryptocurrency built to empower economic freedom.
Our vision for Zcash is that it will provide equal access to economic systems and give everyone the ability to participate in economic activity.
